h1: Promotional Drinkware Supply for Brand Campaigns
lead: Plan campaign drinkware around the product, audience, artwork and distribution format. We supply custom drinkware with free design proposals and product visual mockups.
html:
Separate serving products from gift products

A cup handed out for drink service and a boxed promotional gift can need different components and packing. Define that use before comparing product configurations.

Work backward from distribution

Give the required arrival date, destination, quantity and packing arrangement in the brief. The quote then concerns the complete campaign supply scope rather than an isolated cup price.
